get.description:
Returns a cursor-paginated page of the global points leaderboard,
ordered by cumulative points descending (rank 1 first). Follow the
returned `cursor` via the `after` query parameter to fetch the next
page.

Pagination is stable as long as the underlying rank snapshot is not
refreshed between page fetches.

Requires an API key.

get.summary: Get a team's leaderboard (live or a historical round)
get.description:
A team's backers ranked by fan points. Without `roundId` this is the live
leaderboard: current cumulative points and the estimated reward per rank.
With `roundId` it is the frozen snapshot taken at that round's close:
points as they stood then, ranked, and the payout allocated for the round.
Returns the top `first` entries (default 100, max 500).

get.summary: Get my position on a team's leaderboard (live or a historical round)
get.description:
The authenticated user's own rank and points on a team's leaderboard,
found across the full ranking even when it falls outside the public
leaderboard page. Without `roundId` this is the live standing (current
cumulative points and the estimated reward); with `roundId` it is the
frozen standing at that round's close, with the payout for the round.
`data` is null if the user does not back the team (or has no snapshot in
the requested round).

Signals that `takerAmount` is deflated and represents a signed minimum,
not the actual fill target. When `true` the backend derives the actual
share quantity from the expected cost:
`amount = makerAmount * 1e18 / priceInCurrency`.

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable error codes for all API error responses.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description:
Structured error response body.

Every error path in the API produces this shape.

error.description:
Stable machine-readable error code for client-side matching.

For 400 responses this is the granular bad-request code (e.g.
`create_order_insufficient_collateral_allowance`). For all other
responses it is the HTTP-status-derived code (e.g. `unauthorized`).

allOf.description:
Stable machine-readable error code for client-side matching.

For 400 responses this is the granular bad-request code (e.g.
`create_order_insufficient_collateral_allowance`). For all other
responses it is the HTTP-status-derived code (e.g. `unauthorized`).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the error occurred

trace.description: Trace ID for correlating with server logs

type.description: The fee side, either COLLATERAL (e.g. USDT) or SHARES

allOf.description: The fee side, either COLLATERAL (e.g. USDT) or SHARES

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description:
A single entry on the global points leaderboard.

The `rank` is descending where rank 1 is equivalent to having
the highest cumulative points.

totalPoints.description: Cumulative all-time points balance for this account.

name.description: Display name of the account, empty string if unset.

imageUrl.description: Profile image URL, only present when the account's image is public.

Null when the category has no linked game yet.

SportsPropsMarketData.description:
Per-market data for `SPORTS_PROPS` prop markets.

Fields are market-type-specific: `spreadSide` is set for spread markets,
`line` is set for totals markets. Both-teams-to-score markets emit no
`variantData` of this shape.

spreadSide.description: Which side of the parent match this spread market is on. Present for spread markets only.

allOf.description: Which side of the parent match this spread market is on. Present for spread markets only.

line.description: The line value for this totals market. Present for totals markets only.

SportsTeamOutcomeData.title: SportsTeamOutcomeData
SportsTeamOutcomeData.description: Outcome variant data for sports markets where the outcome maps to a team.

TeamSide.description: Which side of a sports match a team plays on.

TimeseriesBatchData.title: TimeseriesBatchData
TimeseriesBatchData.description: `resolution` is shared across all markets in the request.

TimeseriesData.title: TimeseriesData
TimeseriesData.description: Inner data for the timeseries response

resolution.description: The resolution of the returned data points

allOf.description: The resolution of the returned data points

series.description: Data points ordered by time ascending

TimeseriesLatestData.title: TimeseriesLatestData
TimeseriesLatestData.description: Inner data for the latest timeseries response

tweetCount.description: Current count of tweets within the category date range

types are handled gracefully by the [`deserialize_variant_data`] helper

WeeklyPointsEntry.title: WeeklyPointsEntry
WeeklyPointsEntry.description: A single week of points data

week.description: Sequential week index, starting at 1 for the first round.

userPoints.description:
Points earned by the authenticated user that week, restricted to
the leaderboard-eligible sources.

`0` until the weekly calculation is finalised, check `calculated`
to disambiguate from a real zero.

userReferralPoints.description: Subset of points attributable to referral sources.

allocationAmount.description: The budgeted point allocation for the round.

calculated.description:
Whether the weekly calculation has been finalised.

When `false`, the point fields will be `0`, as the round is still
in-progress / "TBD". Distribution happens on a near-weekly cadence.

WorldCupCategoryRef.title: WorldCupCategoryRef
WorldCupCategoryRef.description:
The trading category a question's options sit under. The trading page is
keyed by the slug (for example `/market/{slug}`).

WorldCupContestPool.title: WorldCupContestPool
WorldCupContestPool.description:
A contest's prize pool and how it splits across the contest's teams: a group's
teams in the group stage, or the two teams of a match in a knockout.

total.description: Total prize pool for the contest, in USDT base units.

rankBreakdown.description:
The per-rank slices of the pool (rank 1 first). Empty for a knockout pool,
which is winner-takes-all.

teams.description: The contest's teams, ordered by rank, each with its slice of the pool.

WorldCupContestTeam.title: WorldCupContestTeam
WorldCupContestTeam.description: A team's place in a contest and its slice of the contest pool.

points.description: The team's real-world points in the contest. Null before play.

rank.description: The team's rank in the contest (1 = top). Null before play.

poolSlice.description: This team's slice of the contest pool, in USDT base units.

WorldCupGameRef.title: WorldCupGameRef
WorldCupGameRef.description: The match a scorable question belongs to.

gameId.description: The match's stable game identifier, usable to cross-reference match data.

roundName.description: The round's display name, for example "Group Stage".

groupName.description: The group this match belongs to, when applicable.

home.description: The home team of the fixture. Exact-score goals are home-then-away.

allOf.description: The home team of the fixture. Exact-score goals are home-then-away.

away.description: The away team of the fixture.

allOf.description: The away team of the fixture.

kickoff.description: When the match kicks off and picks lock (RFC 3339).

WorldCupLeaderboardEntry.title: WorldCupLeaderboardEntry
WorldCupLeaderboardEntry.description:
One backer's standing on a team's leaderboard. The live leaderboard (no
`roundId`) carries the current cumulative points and the `estimatedReward`; a
historical round snapshot (`roundId` set) carries the points as they stood at
that round's close and the `payout` allocated for it.

username.description: The backer's display name, when set; otherwise null (fall back to address).

points.description: Cumulative fan points (current on the live board, at-close on a snapshot).

estimatedReward.description:
Estimated reward for this rank, in USDT base units. Live board only; null
on a historical snapshot.

payout.description:
The payout allocated for the round, in USDT base units. Historical snapshot
only (and null until the round's payout is allocated); null on the live board.

WorldCupLock.title: WorldCupLock
WorldCupLock.description:
One of the viewer's locks: a committed pick on a scorable question, with its
match context and how it is tracking toward earning points.

team.description: The team whose leaderboard this lock feeds.

allOf.description: The team whose leaderboard this lock feeds.

gameId.description: The match's stable game identifier, usable to cross-reference match data.

heldAtStart.description: Whether the minimum position was held at kickoff.

heldAtEnd.description: Whether the minimum position was held at resolution.

purchased.description: Whether the position was bought on the order book (required to qualify).

won.description: Whether the pick was correct, once the market resolves.

pointsAwarded.description: Fan points credited for this pick, once the market resolves.

WorldCupLockResponse.title: WorldCupLockResponse
WorldCupLockResponse.description: The result of locking a pick.

WorldCupLockResult.title: WorldCupLockResult
WorldCupLockResult.description: The outcome locked by a successful lock.

lockedOutcomeId.description: The outcome now locked for the question.

WorldCupLocked.title: WorldCupLocked
WorldCupLocked.description:
The viewer's locked pick on a scorable question and how it is tracking toward
earning points. Inner fields are null until they can be evaluated.

heldAtStart.description: Whether the minimum position was held at kickoff.

heldAtEnd.description: Whether the minimum position was held at resolution.

purchased.description:
Whether the committed position was bought on the order book, a requirement
for the pick to qualify.

won.description: Whether the pick was correct, once the market resolves.

pointsAwarded.description: Fan points credited for this pick, once the market resolves.

WorldCupMyStanding.title: WorldCupMyStanding
WorldCupMyStanding.description:
The authenticated viewer's own standing on a team's leaderboard. Live (no
`roundId`) carries the estimated reward; a historical round (`roundId` set)
carries the payout for that round.

WorldCupOption.title: WorldCupOption
WorldCupOption.description:
An option a backer may lock for a scorable question. Both sides of the match
are offered, so a backer may lock the opponent's outcome too. `marketId`,
`indexSet` and the question's category are everything needed to send a backer
to trade the option. Extra fields appear by question type: `line` for spread
and total goals; `scoreType` / `homeGoals` / `awayGoals` for exact score.

marketOutcomeId.description: The market outcome this option backs, and that the backer must hold.

marketId.description: The market the outcome belongs to.

indexSet.description: The outcome's index within its market (which side).

name.description: The underlying market outcome's name, for example "Yes" / "No" on a moneyline leg, or "Over" / "Under".

title.description: The option's display label, for example "Brazil", "Draw", or "Over 2.5".

heldShares.description:
The authenticated viewer's position in this outcome, in share base units.
Populated only by the personalised questions endpoint; otherwise null.

line.description: The handicap or total line. Present only on spread and total-goals options.

scoreType.description:
`EXACT` for a specific scoreline or `OTHER` for the catch-all. Present only
on exact-score options.

homeGoals.description:
The home team's goals for an exact scoreline, null for the catch-all.
Present only on exact-score options.

awayGoals.description:
The away team's goals for an exact scoreline, null for the catch-all.
Present only on exact-score options.

WorldCupPoolResponse.title: WorldCupPoolResponse
WorldCupPoolResponse.description: A contest's prize pool, null if none is configured.

WorldCupQuestion.title: WorldCupQuestion
WorldCupQuestion.description:
A scorable question for one of a team's matches: a proposition such as
"Money line" or "Exact Score", with the options a backer may lock. The
question is scored toward one team's leaderboard, but a backer may lock any
option, including the opponent's side.

team.description: The team whose leaderboard this question feeds.

allOf.description: The team whose leaderboard this question feeds.

game.description: The match this question belongs to.

allOf.description: The match this question belongs to.

type.description: The proposition kind, for example "MONEYLINE" or "EXACT_SCORE".

sortOrder.description:
The proposition kind's display order, lowest first. Questions are returned
sorted by kickoff and then this order, so a client can render them as
received or re-group them consistently.

title.description: The question's title, for example "Money line".

fanPoints.description: Fan points earned for a correct, qualifying pick.

minShares.description: Minimum position required to lock an option, in share base units.

category.description: The trading category the question's options sit under.

allOf.description: The trading category the question's options sit under.

options.description: Every option a backer may lock for this question.

locked.description:
The viewer's locked pick and its state. Populated only by the personalised
endpoint; null otherwise or when no pick is locked.

allOf.description:
The viewer's locked pick and its state. Populated only by the personalised
endpoint; null otherwise or when no pick is locked.

WorldCupRankSlice.title: WorldCupRankSlice
WorldCupRankSlice.description:
One finishing rank's slice of a contest pool, for example rank 1 takes 75% of
a group pool. The ladder before teams are assigned to ranks.

amount.description: The slice for this rank, in USDT base units.

WorldCupRound.title: WorldCupRound
WorldCupRound.description: A tournament round and the prize pool on offer for it.

name.description: The round's display name, for example "Group Stage".

poolCount.description:
Number of pools in this round: one per group in the group stage, one per
match in a knockout round.

perPoolAmount.description: The amount of each pool in this round, in USDT base units.

totalAmount.description: The round's total prize pool, in USDT base units.

WorldCupRoundDetail.title: WorldCupRoundDetail
WorldCupRoundDetail.description: A round and the advancement result of every team that plays in it.

WorldCupRoundDetailResponse.title: WorldCupRoundDetailResponse
WorldCupRoundDetailResponse.description: A round and the advancement result of each team that plays in it.

WorldCupRoundHistoryEntry.title: WorldCupRoundHistoryEntry
WorldCupRoundHistoryEntry.description:
One round in a backer's history for a team: their rank and cumulative points
at that round's close, and the payout for it.

points.description: Cumulative fan points at this round's close.

payout.description:
The payout allocated for this round, in USDT base units. Null until it is
allocated.

dispersed.description: Whether the payout for this round has been dispersed on-chain.

WorldCupRoundHistoryResponse.title: WorldCupRoundHistoryResponse
WorldCupRoundHistoryResponse.description: The viewer's per-round history on a team's leaderboard.

WorldCupRoundRef.title: WorldCupRoundRef
WorldCupRoundRef.description: A minimal round reference: identifier and display name.

name.description: The round's display name, for example "Group Stage".

WorldCupRoundTeam.title: WorldCupRoundTeam
WorldCupRoundTeam.description:
A team in a round with its advancement result, one of `ADVANCED`,
`ELIMINATED`, or `PENDING`.

WorldCupStandingResponse.title: WorldCupStandingResponse
WorldCupStandingResponse.description:
The viewer's own standing on a team's leaderboard, null if they do not back it
(or have no snapshot in the requested round).

WorldCupTeam.title: WorldCupTeam
WorldCupTeam.description: A team competing in the tournament, with how many users currently back it.

teamName.description: The team's display name, for example "Japan".

teamKey.description: The team's short code, used for flags and as the key in other endpoints.

groupName.description: The group the team plays in, for example "Group A".

backers.description: How many users currently back this team.

WorldCupTeamEntriesResponse.title: WorldCupTeamEntriesResponse
WorldCupTeamEntriesResponse.description: The teams a user has selected.

WorldCupTeamEntry.title: WorldCupTeamEntry
WorldCupTeamEntry.description: One of the teams a user has selected to back through the tournament.

WorldCupTeamRef.title: WorldCupTeamRef
WorldCupTeamRef.description: A team reference: display name and short key.

name.description: The team's display name, for example "Brazil".

key.description: The team's short code, used for flags and as the key in other endpoints.

WorldCupTeamsResponse.title: WorldCupTeamsResponse
WorldCupTeamsResponse.description: The teams competing in the tournament.

WorldCupUnlockResponse.title: WorldCupUnlockResponse
WorldCupUnlockResponse.description: The result of deleting a lock.

WorldCupUnlockResult.title: WorldCupUnlockResult
WorldCupUnlockResult.description: The outcome of deleting a lock.

removed.description: Whether a lock was removed (false if there was none).

ApiKeyAuth.description: API key authentication via the `x-api-key` header.
ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key

BearerAuth.description: Bearer authentication via the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.
